observed: The run completed the bounded-load and corrupt-chain controls, then hung in empty_v1_migrates while sqlite3.Connection.backup was called from the same source connection after BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
consequence: A migration could deadlock before preserving its predecessor or changing the schema.
repair: Create and verify a transaction-consistent backup first, publish it atomically, then acquire a new immediate source transaction, reverify the exact source frame against the backup head/count and migrate only if unchanged.
validator_correction: The first post-repair validator run falsely failed predecessor_preserved because it checked the temporary fixture path after the TemporaryDirectory had been removed. The check was moved inside the fixture lifetime; product migration tests were already passing.
nonclaim: Observed on the Windows local SQLite fixture; it does not establish behavior for every SQLite build or filesystem.
